title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure
abstract: arXiv:2610.37731v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. translated_title: 用于模型校准的摊销式局部化后验推断及其在海洋湍流闭合中的应用
translated_abstract: 模型差异可能使单一校准参数无法在整个情境域上重现物理响应。此外，观测和情境中的不确定性会影响校准，必须加以考虑和量化。我们通过根据观测似然与目标情境的接近程度对其加权，构建了一族局部化后验分布。高斯局部化权重通过协方差膨胀来纳入情境不确定性，并在域边界处进行反射处理，同时提供针对情境采样不均匀的可选校正。我们通过摊销式变分推断，利用条件归一化流来近似这族后验分布。在给定的情境测度下对局部化后验进行积分，即可得到边缘化的参数分布。在基于Branin-Hoo模型的孪生实验中，我们在均匀和偏斜的情境分布下比较了全局推断与局部化推断。局部化降低了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯局部化权重与条件归一化流的摊销式局部化后验推断框架，用于解决单一校准参数无法跨越不同情境重现物理响应的模型校准问题，并同时量化观测与情境的不确定性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an amortized localized posterior inference framework based on Gaussian localization weights and a conditional normalizing flow, which addresses model calibration when a single parameter cannot reproduce physical responses across the context domain, while quantifying observation and context uncertainties.
